description:
New to the Market – Exceptional Lakeside Residence with c.28.5 Acres & Income-Producing Lands
Lough Talit, Aclare, Co. Sligo – F91 CC44

Guide Price: €750,000

Nigel Dineen & Martin Finn Auctioneers are proud to present this outstanding architecturally designed detached bungalow, set on an elevated holding of c.28.5 acres, commanding spectacular uninterrupted views over Lough Talit and the surrounding mountains.

This is a rare, high-value lifestyle and investment opportunity, combining a luxury residence, substantial landholding, commonage rights and an established annual income stream of approximately €22,000.

Properties of this calibre, offering location, scale, income and finish, rarely come to the market.

Accommodation Comprises:

Entrance Hall:
Spacious with porcelain mosaic tiled flooring.

Open Plan Living / Dining Area:
A truly exceptional space featuring vaulted ceiling, large patio doors overlooking Lough Talit and a picture window to the mountains, creating a bright, open and panoramic living environment.

Kitchen:
Fully fitted modern kitchen with new appliances, touchscreen hob, recessed lighting and feature open fireplace with marble surround, with direct access to patio, garden and garage.

Bedrooms:

Master Bedroom: Oak timber flooring with stunning lake and mountain views
Ensuite: Fully tiled with walk-in shower and quality fittings

Bedrooms 2 & 3: Finished with oak timber flooring and high-quality detailing

Bathrooms:
Main bathroom fully tiled with views of the lake

Guest WC fully tiled with quality fittings

Garage & Outbuildings:
Large double garage with electric roller doors
WC and WHB installed

Additional outbuildings on site
Ruins of former dwellings offering further potential

Land & Income:
c.28.5 acres of lands surrounding the residence
7/49 share of approx. 1,600 acres of commonage
Annual income of approx. €22,000 from the lands

Features:
Elevated site with panoramic lake views

Vaulted ceiling enhancing space and light
High-end finishes throughout

Oil-fired central heating
PVC windows and doors

Private and peaceful setting

Location:
Overlooking Lough Talit – renowned fishing and scenic destination

Close to Aclare Village
Within reach of Sligo Town and major routes

Exceptional natural setting with strong lifestyle appeal

This property represents a unique opportunity to acquire a turnkey lakeside residence with substantial lands and proven income, offering both lifestyle and long-term investment value.

Viewing is strictly by appointment only.
